description:
One class level. Every number the level row carries the engine writes itself; this is
what the row cannot answer.

picks.description: Exactly the picks the offer asks for, from its options; a level that offers no alternatives takes none.

spells.description: Exactly the cantrips and spells the offer says this level adds, from the legal spells it lists.
spells.title: Spells

abilities.description: Empty unless the offer says this level raises ability scores: then the new value of each ability raised, spending every point the offer names, none above 20.
abilities.title: Abilities
